anya: Quick flag — bringing up int4 gpt-small-v2 in quant pipeline, seen big ROUGE/BLEU regression vs fp16.

cameron: Details?

anya: Suspect tokenizer drift. Baseline image had tokenizers==2.8.0, quant image pulled 3.1.0 via transitive dep. Repro logs:
```
INFO loading tokenizer v3.1.0
WARN tokenized: "I'm  fine" (double spaces)
WARN shard count mismatch: processed=2004 expected=2000
```

liam: Tokenizer whitespace changes alone can tank BLEU/ROUGE. BERTScore more tolerant but param-sensitive.

sophia: Also the sharder in the runner appears to assign the remainder shard twice when num_workers > 8. That gives extra samples and makes pass@k math wrong.

cameron: Hmm I thought we had a sentinel for remainder. I'll inspect the parallel sharder loop. If true, pass@k denominator will be off.

anya: Another subtle one: our pass@k dedupe uses semantic similarity (bert-sim) + norming. For datasets where multiple valid paraphrases exist, semantic dedupe removes near-variants and inflates pass@k.

liam: We should standardize dedupe to deterministic string normalization (NFKC + collapse whitespace + lowercase) and keep semantic cluster as opt-in.

sophia: Found metric config drift too: quant-run used BERTScore with idf=false, baseline idf=true. Small but consistent bias.

cameron: So root causes: tokenizer version mismatch, sharder remainder bug, and metric param drift. All three together explains the delta.

anya: Short-term: reverting tokenizer to 2.8 in the job image and re-running smoke eval. Queued now.

liam: I'll open PR to: 1) enforce metric-config checksum in harness, 2) change pass@k dedupe to deterministic norm, 3) add explicit tokenizer version assert before eval starts.

sophia: Can we add a CI canary that runs a 200-sample smoke with tok v3 and tok v2 and fails rollout if BLEU/ROUGE delta > 3% or pass@1 delta > 2%? Would catch this earlier.

ci-bot: [eval-runner-quant-1987654321] failed — artifacts: /artifacts/eval/1987654321. Logs uploaded.

cameron: I'll pair with @sophia tomorrow, will also patch sharder. Creating ticket EV-4139 and adding artifacts + checklist. Ping me with PRs.

anya: Thx — I'll post the revert run outputs here when ready. :+1:
